Absorption

Anna Marie LeBeau/Rogue (Marvel Comics) can absorb the powers, energies, memories, knowledge, talents, personality and physical abilities (whether superhuman or not) of other beings through physical contact of her skin with the skin…

Power/Ability to:

Absorb anything.

The power to absorb anything and utilize it in some way. Sub-power of Absorption Manipulation. Opposite to Expulsion.

Also Called[]

  • Absorbing/Assimilation
  • Drain/Draining
  • Siphon
  • Siphoning Ability
  • Supernatural Absorption
  • Supernatural Assimilation

Capabilities[]

The user can absorb literally anything/everything, including matter/energy, power, concepts, etc, and utilize it in some way. They can absorb powers, energies, memories, knowledge, talents, abilities, skills, etc. with just a touch. They remove it from the source into their body and use it in various ways to gain some form of advantage: enhancing themselves, gaining the drained power or concept, rejuvenating themselves or using it as a power source etc., either temporarily or permanently. This can also extend to storage their subject within themselves, or an aspect of themselves, to utilize later in some way.

Limitations[]

  • Absorption Immunity/Absorption Negation
  • User can be overpowered by Omni-Absorption.
  • Anti Storage users are immune to this power (if it tries to keep them sealed/separate from/alive within the absorber).
  • May be limited to how much one can absorb.
  • May be limited to what one can absorb (such as organic over technological).
  • May have limited range, including touch only.
  • May not be protected from the damage caused by the absorbed substance/energy.
  • After absorbing something (for example, life-force or power etc.), it will probably be irreversible.
  • May not be able to take on the appearance of the one or many beings that are being absorbed by the opponent (I.E. Doma absorbing Shinobu Kocho in Demon Slayer, Super Buu absorbing Gotenks and Piccolo in Dragon Ball Z the said latter of which took on Piccolos' high intelligence rather than his appearance).
